hooks.prompt:
A git commit was just made. Run:
  git -C "H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant" diff HEAD~1 HEAD

Analyze the diff for structural changes: new modules or packages, renamed/moved directories, new or changed config files (pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, etc.), new top-level scripts. If any structural change is present, update CLAUDE.md and/or ARCHITECTURE.md under H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant/ to reflect the new structure.

Skip (make no edits) if the diff contains only minor code fixes, logic changes within existing functions, or comment/docstring changes.
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for structural changes to document...

hooks.prompt:
A git commit was just made. Run:
  git -C "H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant" diff HEAD~1 HEAD

Focus on __init__.py files and any public .py file (not prefixed with underscore). Check whether any public symbol (function, class, or constant without a leading underscore) was added, removed, or had its signature modified between HEAD~1 and HEAD.

If public API changed, append a new entry to H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant/API_CHANGES.md using this format:

## YYYY-MM-DD
- <module>: <description of change>

Skip entirely if only private symbols (leading underscore) changed, or if no .py files were touched.

A git commit was just made. Run:
  git -C "H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant" diff HEAD~1 HEAD

Check whether any import statements changed in the diff (lines beginning with 'import' or 'from ... import'). If import statements changed, read the module structure under H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant/ and update the module dependency section of H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant/ARCHITECTURE.md to reflect the current inter-module dependencies.

Skip entirely if no import lines appear in the diff.

hooks.command:
BRANCH=$(git -C "H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown") && COMMIT=$(git -C "H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant" log -1 --oneline 2>/dev/null || echo "none") && SUMMARY=$(cat "H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant/.claude/session-summary.md" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no summary)") && printf '## %s
- Branch: %s
- Commit: %s

%s

---

' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$BRANCH" "$COMMIT" "$SUMMARY" >> "H:/GitHub.06.2022/tme-quant/src/tme_quant/.claude/session-log.md"
